message: Vector Rebel v2.3.1 beta is current. If Vector Rebel cannot independently confirm a completed inspection in the Item Log, verify it there before running that item again.
releaseNotes: Vector Rebel redesign with simplified user UI, local Captain Sets, admin-maintained master roster, launch-from-anywhere navigation, duplicate-instance and cross-tab run protection, signature visual-follow scrolling, safer roster mapping correction, and Item Log completion verification.
